description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'SeoRegex' model class within the OpenCart framework, specifically for the admin design module. It manages SEO regex records, providing methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve individual, multiple, and count SEO regex entries in the database.

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: Model class for managing SEO regex entries, including CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

methods.name: addSeoRegex
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO regex record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editSeoRegex
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO regex record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteSeoRegex
methods.description: Deletes the SEO regex record with the specified ID from the database.

methods.name: getSeoRegex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SEO regex record by its ID.

methods.name: getSeoRegexes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SEO regex records, optionally paginated.

methods.name: getTotalSeoRegexes
methods.description: Returns the total number of SEO regex records stored.
